# Monthly Binning
```{r}
sonoma = read.csv("SONOMA-Data/sonoma_cleaned_3_20260220.csv")
#start_dates <- tribble(
#  ~coda_site, ~start_date,
#  "Atrium Health", as.Date("9/29/2023", "%m/%d/%Y"),
#  "CODA", as.Date("9/29/2023", "%m/%d/%Y"),
#  )

start_dates <- tribble(
  ~site_name, ~start_date,
  "Atrium Health", as.Date("9/29/2023", "%m/%d/%Y"),
  "Boston Medical Center",  as.Date("9/24/2023", "%m/%d/%Y"),
  "Columbia University Medical Center",  as.Date("9/27/2023", "%m/%d/%Y"),
  "University of Iowa Hospital and Clinics",  as.Date("9/9/2023", "%m/%d/%Y"),
  "Grady Health System",  as.Date("11/17/2023", "%m/%d/%Y"),
  "Michigan Medicine",  as.Date("10/30/2023", "%m/%d/%Y"),
  "Harborview Medical Center",  as.Date("10/3/2023", "%m/%d/%Y"),
  "University of Washington-Montlake",  as.Date("9/27/2023", "%m/%d/%Y"),
  "Northwest Hospital-University of Washington",  as.Date("9/26/2023", "%m/%d/%Y"))
#inclusion/exclusion---------------------
#drop LBJ just for this analysis - incomplete data
sonoma <- sonoma %>% filter(site_name != 'Lyndon B Johnson Hospital')

#final inclusion
sonoma <- sonoma %>% filter(eligiblefull == 1) 

#factor creation---------------------
sonoma <- sonoma %>% mutate(plan = factor(initial_planoutcomes, levels = c(1, 2), labels = c("Appendectomy", "NOM")))

sonoma = sonoma %>% mutate(coda_site = case_when(
                            site_name == "Atrium Health" ~ "Non-CODA",  site_name == "Grady Health System" ~ "Non-CODA", 
                            TRUE ~ "CODA")) 


#create monthly data per site-----------------------------
sonoma <- sonoma %>% 
  mutate(
      firstdxoutcomes = as.Date(firstdxoutcomes)) %>%
  filter(firstdxoutcomes >= "2023-01-01" & firstdxoutcomes <= "2024-08-01") %>% 
  left_join(start_dates, by = "site_name") %>% 
  mutate(
    start_date = as.Date(start_date)) %>%  
  mutate(period = case_when((firstdxoutcomes < start_date) ~ "Pre",
                            (firstdxoutcomes >= start_date)  ~ "Post"),
                    site_name = factor(site_name),
                    plan_num = as.numeric((plan)) -1,
  ) %>% 
  select(c("site_name", "coda_site", "period", "plan", "plan_num","firstdxoutcomes")) %>% 
  drop_na()

sonoma$coda_site <- factor(sonoma$coda_site, 
                                levels = c("CODA", setdiff(unique(sonoma$coda_site), "CODA")))
sonoma$period <- factor(sonoma$period, 
                                levels = c("Pre", setdiff(unique(sonoma$period), "Pre")))
```

```{r}
coda_non_coda = sonoma %>%
  mutate(month = as.Date(floor_date(firstdxoutcomes, unit = "month"))) %>%
  group_by(coda_site, month) %>%
  summarise(
    p =  mean(plan == "NOM")
  ) %>%
  filter(month > as.Date("2022-12-01") & month < as.Date("2024-08-30"))
```

```{r}
p = ggplot(data = coda_non_coda, aes(x = month, y = p, color = coda_site)) + 
    geom_point() + geom_smooth() + 
   scale_color_manual(values = c("CODA" = "#6e13a7",
                                  "Non-CODA" = "#b8a016")) +
    xlab("") + 
    ylab("NOM Proportion") +
    labs(title = "Smoothed Monthly NOM Proportion", color = "CODA Participation", linetype = "", size = "Observations")  + coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, .35))

ggsave("/home/users/sherold/Documents/SONOMA-figures/coda_non_coda.png", plot = p, width = 10, height = 6)
```


```{r}
two_by_two <- sonoma %>%
  group_by(coda_site, period) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), p =  mean(plan == "NOM"), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(type = "Observed")

two_by_two = rbind(
  two_by_two,
  data.frame(
    coda_site = "Non-CODA",
    period = "Pre",
    n = 194,
    p = 0.066,
    type = "Counterfactual"
  )
)
two_by_two = rbind(
  two_by_two,
  data.frame(
    coda_site = "Non-CODA",
    period = "Post",
    n = 1,
    p = 0.066 +  0.0208,
    type = "Counterfactual"
  )
)
two_by_two <- two_by_two %>%
  mutate(
    type = factor(type),
    coda_site = factor(coda_site),
    period = factor(period)
  )
two_by_two <- two_by_two %>%
  mutate(group = c(1,1, 2,2, 3,3), group = factor(group)) %>%
  mutate(
    se = sqrt(( p * (1 -  p)) / n),
    lower = max(0, p - 1.96 * se),
    upper = min(1, p + 1.96 * se)
  )
head(sonoma)
  ```

```{r}
two_by_two_plot = ggplot(data = two_by_two, aes(x = period, y = p, color = coda_site, group = group, linetype = type)) + 
    geom_point(aes(, size = n)) + 
    scale_size(range = c(.1, 6)) +
    geom_line() +    
    scale_linetype_manual(values = c("Observed" = "solid",
                                  "Counterfactual" = "dotted")) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("CODA" = "#6e13a7",
                                  "Non-CODA" = "#b8a016")) +
    xlab("") + 
    ylab("NOM Proportion") +
    labs(title = "DiD 2x2", color = "CODA Participation", linetype = "", size = "Observations")  + ylim(0, .35)

ggsave("/home/users/sherold/Documents/SONOMA-figures/two_by_two.png", plot = two_by_two_plot, width = 6, height = 6)

```

```{r}
# Model 1 

lm1 = glm(plan ~ period + coda_site + period*coda_site, 
    data = sonoma, 
    family=binomial(link = "identity"),
    )
summary(lm1)

vc <- vcovCL(lm1, cluster =sonoma$site_name)
coeftest(lm1, vcov = vc)
coefci(lm1, vcov = vc)
```


```{R}
# Model 2
library(lme4)
library(performance)
m1 <- glmer(
  plan ~ period * coda_site + (1 | site_name),
  data = sonoma,
  family = binomial(link = "logit")
)
summary(m1)
exp(coef(summary(m1)))
exp(confint(m1))
icc(m1)

##################################################

m1 <- glmer(
  plan ~ 1 + (1 | site_name),
  data = sonoma,
  family = binomial(link = "logistic")
)
summary(m1)
icc(m1)
vc <- VarCorr(m1)

library(SUMMER)
rates = (sonoma %>% group_by(site_name) %>% summarize(NOM_rate =  sum(plan == "NOM", na.rm = TRUE)/n()) %>% select(NOM_rate))
sd(rates$NOM_rate)

mean((sonoma %>% group_by(site_name) %>% summarize(v  =  sd(plan_num)))$v)

.105 / (.409 + .105)
```


```{R}
# Model 3
library(geepack)
library(performance)
library(broom)

g1 <- geeglm(
  plan_num ~ period * coda_site,  
  id = site_name,            
  data = sonoma %>% arrange(site_name),
  family = binomial(link = "logit"), 
  corstr = "exchangeable")
summary(g1)
exp(coef(summary(g1)))
exp(tidy(g1, conf.int = TRUE)[,2:7])
```


```{R}
# Parallel Trends

sonoma_pre = sonoma %>% filter(period == 'Pre') 
sonoma_pre$day_num <- as.numeric(sonoma_pre$firstdxoutcomes)
sonoma_pre$day_num = (sonoma_pre$day_num - mean(sonoma_pre$day_num))
head(sonoma)

# (1) 
lm_pre = glm(plan ~ day_num*coda_site, 
    data = sonoma_pre, 
    family=binomial(link = "identity"),
    )
vc <- vcovCL(lm_pre, cluster =sonoma_pre$site_name)
coeftest(lm_pre, vcov = vc)
coefci(lm_pre, vcov = vc)

# (2)
m1_pre <- glmer(
  plan ~ day_num*coda_site + (1 | site_name),
  data = sonoma_pre,
  family = binomial(link = "logit")
)
summary(m1_pre)
exp(coef(summary(m1_pre)))
exp(confint(m1_pre))
icc(m1_pre)

# (3)
gee_pre = geeglm(
  plan_num ~ day_num*coda_site,  
  id = site_name,            
  data = sonoma_pre %>% arrange(site_name),
  family = binomial(link = "logit"), 
  corstr = "exchangeable")

summary(gee_pre)
exp(coef(summary(gee_pre)))
exp(tidy(gee_pre, conf.int = TRUE)[,2:7])

lm_show = glm(plan ~ day_num*coda_site, 
    data = sonoma_pre, 
    family=binomial(link = "logit"),
    )
summary(lm_show)
sonoma_pre$fitted = predict(lm_show, type = "response")

(-0.000113 +  0.0004) * 100 *30
```

```{R}
# All Trends

sonoma_clean = sonoma 
sonoma_clean$day_num <- as.numeric(sonoma_clean$firstdxoutcomes)
sonoma_clean$day_num = (sonoma_clean$day_num - mean(sonoma_clean$day_num))

lm_all = glm(plan ~ period + coda_site + period*coda_site + day_num*coda_site,
    data = sonoma_clean, 
    family=binomial(link = "identity"),
    )
vc <- vcovCL(lm_all, cluster =sonoma_clean$site_name)
coeftest(lm_all, vcov = vc)

m1_all <- glmer(
  plan ~ period + coda_site + period*coda_site + day_num*coda_site+ (1 | site_name),
  data = sonoma_clean,
  family = binomial(link = "logit")
)
summary(m1_all)


gee_all = geeglm(
  plan_num ~ period + coda_site + period*coda_site + day_num,  
  id = site_name,            
  data = sonoma_clean %>% arrange(site_name),
  family = binomial(link = "logit"), 
  corstr = "exchangeable")

summary(gee_all)

lm_show = glm(plan ~ period + coda_site + period*coda_site + day_num*coda_site, 
    data = sonoma_clean , 
    family=binomial(link = "logit"),
    )
summary(lm_show)
sonoma_clean$fitted = predict(lm_show, type = "response")
```


```{r}


sonoma_clean_month = sonoma_clean %>%
```
